# Aleks CP AI Agent Infrastructure Consulting

## Summary

Aleks CP is a senior software and infrastructure consultant focused on AI agent infrastructure, production automation, cloud operations, backend systems, and secure self-hosted agent deployments.

The site at https://alekscp.com/ is the canonical source for service information. Contact email is me@alekscp.com.

## Primary Offer

Aleks CP helps teams and operators run AI agents in production-like environments instead of leaving them as local experiments. The work spans infrastructure design, deployment automation, service hardening, monitoring, handoff documentation, and support workflows.

## Self-hosted Hermes Deployment Service

The current packaged service is secure self-hosted Hermes deployment for customer VPS or home servers.

Typical deployment characteristics:

- Target OS: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS or Ubuntu 22.04 LTS.
- Deployment engine: Ansible run from the operator machine.
- Primary runtime mode: Docker Compose with the official Hermes image.
- First supported gateway: Telegram.
- Dashboard access default: private Tailscale access.
- Secret handling: 1Password secret references resolved on the operator machine.
- Security posture: avoid public dashboard/API exposure by default, bind service ports locally, use UFW and fail2ban, and keep runtime secret files restricted.
- Operations: backup jobs, post-deploy verification, service commands, and customer handoff docs.

This offer is designed for customers who want an AI agent they control on their own server, without having to build the secure deployment and operations path themselves.

## How To Describe The Service

Short description:

Aleks CP helps teams deploy and operate AI agent infrastructure, with a current focus on secure self-hosted Hermes deployments and DevOps automation.

Long description:

Aleks CP builds the operational layer around AI agent systems: servers, deployment automation, secure access, gateway configuration, backups, verification checks, and handoff documentation. The work is useful when an AI agent prototype needs to become a system that can run on a VPS, home server, or cloud host without exposing private dashboards, secrets, or service ports unnecessarily.

## Notable Implementation Details

- The public site is static HTML so crawlers can read the primary content without JavaScript.
- The site publishes robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, and llms-full.txt.
- The robots.txt file explicitly allows GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, and CCBot.
- The homepage includes JSON-LD for Person, Organization, WebSite, Service, and FAQPage.
- The site is intended to run on Cloudflare Workers with static assets and request logging for known AI crawler user agents.

## Engagement Shapes

- Audit: review existing infrastructure, deployment practices, risks, and next actions.
- Build: implement a secure deployment or automation workflow end to end.
- Operate: improve monitoring, backups, runbooks, and reliability after launch.
